''The Septembrians'' | ground = Stadion Dragalevtsi, Sofia | capacity = 1,500 | chairman = Rumen Chandarov | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Simão Freitas]] | league = [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]] | season = [[2024–25 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2024–25]] | position = First League, 12th of 16 | pattern_la1 = _septemvri_19_20_h | pattern_b1 = _septemvri_26_27_h | pattern_ra1 = _septemvri_19_20_h | pattern_sh1 = _septemvri_19_20_h | pattern_so1 = _Septemvri_19_20_h | leftarm1 = 9B111E | body1 = 9B111E | rightarm1 = 9B111E | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 9B111E | pattern_la2 = _uhlsportsquad27wab | pattern_b2 = _uhlsportsquad27wab | pattern_ra2 = _uhlsportsquad27wab | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 0000FF | socks2 = FFFFFF | website = {{URL|https://fcseptemvri.com/}} }} '''FC Septemvri Sofia''' ({{langx|bg|ФК Септември София}})[https://fcseptemvri.com/ Начало | ФК Септември София] is a Bulgarian professional [[association football]] club based in [[Sofia]], which currently competes in the [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]], the top tier of Bulgarian football. Its home ground is the [[Septemvri Stadium (Sofia)|Septemvri Stadium]], but due to its poor condition the team plays its home matches at the Stadion Dragalevtsi or on the [[Vasil Levski National Stadium]]. The club's biggest success to date is the winning of the [[Bulgarian Cup]] in 1960 and finishing 5th in the Bulgarian first division during the same season. Septemvri is known for its strong youth academy, which over the years has developed numerous players for Bulgaria's elite clubs and the national team."}}
